text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since that day at the fast food restaurant,
Jordan and I have been
hard at work
preparing for the Tracen Meet.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm good! I can't let training this basic
tire me out.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Graaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've made it to the last day before the
Tracen Meet. As I turn to go
home after
another day of training, Jordan grabs my
arm.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, um... This is gonna sound low-key
lame, but like... I don't think
I've ever
wanted to win more than I do now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
B-but... what if I lose? Ahaha... What if,
after all that, I still can't—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Pfft...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You trust me waaay too much, you know
that? I mean, I totes
appreciate it, but still!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally, the Tracen Meet arrives.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Tosen Jordan's back? Now that I
think about it, I remember
seeing her
training more lately.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Same here. She seemed to have given up
for a while there, though. I
wonder if she'll
be able to finish today's race...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With emotions running high, the
2,000-meter turf race begins!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Come on, girl, just stay calm. Remember
your training and... Hey, I'm
doing it! I've
got this!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The race is swiftly moving towards the
fourth and final corner! Tosen
Jordan's in a
good position! Can she maintain her lead?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Uraurararaugh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! Gold Ship races forward with
amazing speed! She's
steadily pulling away
from Tosen Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And everyone in my class is already sooo much better than me. I'm sick of being a cringey loser all the time, but that's what's happening...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (If I lose here... If I lose again...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (I'll lose my motivation for real this time!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"That desire to win is going to be your
greatest weapon."
"You can win this. I
promise."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"That desire to win is going to be your
greatest weapon."
"You can win this. I
promise."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Seriously... Always going on and on about
how I can win... Why do
you believe in me
so much anyway?!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ugh, fine! Time to show this crowd a real glow-up!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Tosen Jordan?! Tosen Jordan is
chasing after Gold Ship, and
gaining on
her!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
They're neck and neck! Will it be Gold
Ship?! Tosen Jordan?! Who
will reach the
goal first?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: It's Tosen Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Ehehe, this feeling really is the vibe.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm beat... and ready to pop off! I'm talking
a facial mask, oil massage,
and a little
aromatherapy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That last spurt to first place really got the
crowd going. The
2,000-meter turf race
ends in a roar of applause.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I know, I know! Seriously, you stuck
on repeat or something? I
could hear you
simping during the race too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, real talk... With today's race over,
doesn't that mean our little
deal together
is done too? Just wondering, but... are you
training
anybody right now?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: If not, I was thinking... You kinda need a racer to train to keep your job, right? In that case, I suppose I'd be okay being scouted by you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, if that's what you want.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her invitation may be flippant, but I can
tell she's serious about the
offer. And,
well, I don't have any reason to refuse!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... All right, guess that means we're,
like... a team for real now.
Looking forward
to it, Trainer. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Theeere you areee!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I've been looking aaaall over for you,
bluey! How'd you get so
flishy-flashy?! On
that track, you were like fwoosh, zoom!
Pow! I like
you, gutsy girl!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Say, how about we dig a tunnel all the way
to Brazil?! We'll feel the
heat of the
Earth's mantle together!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? What are you talking about?
You're acting super sus right
now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From that day forward, Gold Ship could
frequently be found hovering
around
Tosen Jordan... But that's a story for
another time.
